title: Just Enough Shifts: Mitigating Over-Refusal in Aligned Language Models with Targeted Representation Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of 'over-refusal' in safety-aligned Large Language Models. It proposes a representation fine-tuning framework (ACTOR) to ensure models are helpful while remaining safe. While it evaluates safety guardrails and uses qualitative examples involving harmful or deceptive queries (like cheating in a board game), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethical/moral frameworks as discrete subjects.
